stories.title: Iran offers a seven-day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz if the US meets its conditions
stories.reason: Foreign Minister Araghchi's proposal, built on the 'Islamabad Framework,' ties reopening the strait to a full ceasefire including Lebanon, release of over $12 billion in frozen assets and lifted oil-export sanctions -- the most concrete offramp floated yet, though the White House has not confirmed acceptance.

stories.title: US Senate narrowly rejects resolution to curb Trump's Iran war powers, 50-49
stories.reason: Four Republicans broke ranks to back the measure and one Democrat opposed it, the closest such vote yet in a war that has pushed up food and fuel prices and left the GOP's slim majority increasingly divided ahead of November's midterms.

stories.title: Xi tells Trump AI must stay 'under human control' as tech CEOs dine at the White House
stories.reason: Nvidia's Jensen Huang, Elon Musk, Tim Cook, Sam Altman, Sergey Brin and Satya Nadella all sat at the state dinner as Xi pushed for shared AI guardrails while Trump rejected any international agreement, saying he wants to 'leave it exactly where it is.'

stories.title: Pope Leo XIV warns a 'paradise of machines' could undermine humanity as he opens his France visit
stories.reason: Speaking to Macron and then to UNESCO diplomats, Leo called nuclear deterrence doctrine 'mistaken' and warned against letting AI and scientific progress erode what it means to be human, extending the themes of his May encyclical on AI and the human person.

stories.title: Supreme Court revives a controversial citizenship-check data system for midterm voter audits
stories.reason: The Court let states resume using the overhauled SAVE system -- linked for the first time to Social Security records -- to screen voter rolls ahead of November, over a dissent from the three liberal justices and despite a lower court finding it had violated federal privacy law and wrongly flagged US citizens.

stories.title: Netanyahu attacks critics including NYC Mayor Mamdani as 'antisemitic' in defiant UN speech, delegates walk out
stories.reason: Netanyahu denied genocide allegations and singled out Mamdani, who has called for his arrest under the ICC warrant against him, as protesters including Susan Sarandon were detained outside -- Mamdani dismissed the speech as 'baseless lies meant to sanitize his genocide against Palestinians.'

stories.title: Zelensky says Ukraine is 'very open' to a Turkey-hosted trilateral summit with Putin and Trump
stories.reason: The offer, made after Zelensky met Erdogan on the UN sidelines, comes as he separately pressed Trump for a winter Patriot-missile package and Kyiv keeps signaling readiness for direct talks even as the Kremlin calls a three-way summit premature.

stories.title: Oil prices fall as investors bet Iran's Hormuz proposal could ease the supply crunch
stories.reason: Brent slid 1.6% to $98.63 a barrel as traders weighed Tehran's seven-day reopening offer against lingering doubts, continuing a pattern where crude swings sharply on every twist in the diplomatic track around the strait.
